notes: Fragmentation is severe and pervasive: many labels share near-verbatim bullets (the Fed-hiking-cycle, ECB-pricing, and Jim Reid bond-normalisation trios in particular repeat the same sentences almost word for word), and JPM's desk notes on EM, tactical stance, longs/shorts, hedges, and positioning are each split three or four ways. At ~41% fragmented mass the ledger badly overstates the number of distinct themes available to an editor.
